verdict.rationale: Puzzle is an accounting SaaS that could plausibly ship an official CLI, so this axis applies. The evidence documents only a REST API with an OpenAPI spec, a ReadMe "Try It!" console, an MCP integration for Claude, and CSV imports. None of these is a command-line tool, and they count only as adjacent building blocks, not an official CLI.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
